title: Autoregressive Frontier Expansion: Growing Trees with Graph Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38506v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tree-like branching structures are common in nature, from botanical trees to neurons, blood vessels and respiratory trees. Their branching shape often reflects function, making structural modelling central to understanding how these systems work. Because acquiring real-world 3D data is often expensive or infeasible, realistic generative models are valuable for simulation and data augmentation. Existing morphology-specific models either constrain how topology is generated or rely on hand-tuned, mechanistic procedures. Generic 3D graph generators, by contrast, do not exploit or enforce the structure of trees. We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that constructs trees through an iterative expansion process, simulating the biological growth of real trees. translated_title: 自回归前沿扩展：基于图机器学习的树木生长
translated_abstract: 树状分支结构在自然界中十分常见，从植物树木到神经元、血管和呼吸树。它们的分支形状往往反映其功能，这使得结构建模成为理解这些系统运行机制的关键。由于获取真实世界的三维数据通常成本高昂或不可行，逼真的生成模型对于仿真和数据增强具有重要价值。现有的形态学专用模型要么限制了拓扑结构的生成方式，要么依赖于手工调整的机制化流程。相比之下，通用的3D图生成器既不利用也不强制树状结构。我们提出了自回归前沿扩展，这是一种通过迭代扩展过程来构建树状结构的生成框架，模拟了真实树木的生物生长过程。在每一步中，由SO(2)等变图神经网络参数化的流匹配模型通过预测每个活跃分支是分叉还是终止来扩展前沿……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了一种名为“自回归前沿扩展”的生成框架，利用SO(2)等变图神经网络结合流匹配模型，通过模拟真实树木的生物生长过程来迭代扩展分支前沿，从而生成逼真的树状分支结构。
en_tdlr: We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that simulates biological tree growth through iterative frontier expansion, using an SO(2)-equivariant GNN with flow matching to predict branch bifurcation or termination at each step.
